summary: Ready Capital filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting that its subsidiary ReadyCap Holdings II closed a private placement of $225.0M 10.00% senior secured notes due 2031 on September 28, 2026, and that indirect subsidiary ReadyCap Holdings LLC completed the previously announced redemption of all $350.0M outstanding 4.50% senior secured notes due 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine debt refinancing—new-issue takeout of a maturing secured series—not a special situation; watch leverage, coupon step-up costs, and collateral release terms.
